headline: Tiafoe from two sets down, then 0-3 in the fifth, then a semi-final
whyCareReason: Michelsen served for the match at 5-4 in the third. Tiafoe won 7-6 (10-6) in the fifth after 4 hours 38 minutes.
teaser: Tiafoe 5-7, 3-6, 7-5, 6-3, 7-6 (10-6) Michelsen. Two sets down. 0-3 in the fifth. A hug at the net.
story:
Why this one matters: an all-American quarter-final on Ashe was supposed to end in the third set. It ended in a 10-point tie-break, with Alex Michelsen crying on Frances Tiafoe's shoulder.

ATP logged the score as 5-7, 3-6, 7-5, 6-3, 7-6 (10-6), 4 hours 38 minutes. Michelsen had not dropped a set in the tournament. He served for the match at 5-4 in the third and double-faulted twice. Tiafoe, the eleventh seed, took that set 7-5, the fourth 6-3, then trailed 0-3 in the fifth. The match tie-break went 10-6 on a Tiafoe forehand down the line.

BBC, ATP and USOpen.org agree on the same numbers. Tiafoe reaches a third US Open semi-final. Michelsen finished with more total points, 173-170, and still lost. The next sentence was Shelton.
stakes: A first American men's semi-final pairing at this Open. One of them had already beaten Alcaraz.
rivalryAngle: Friends, same country, one court, a 23-year drought still unsolved.
